## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The Recension B (Sòng-canon line) of the anonymous Eastern-Jìn *Liùzì shénzhòuwáng jīng*; companion to Recension A [KR6j0243](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0243) (T1045A). For the textual and doctrinal context see [KR6j0242](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0242).

**Abstract**

The two recensions T1045A and T1045B descend through divergent Chinese transmission lines (Korean canon and Sòng canon respectively). Both preserve the same underlying *Liùzì shénzhòu* tradition with minor textual variants. For the broader *ṣaḍ-akṣarī* tradition and the cluster of related Eastern-Jìn six-syllable texts ([KR6j0242](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0242)–[KR6j0245](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0245)) see [KR6j0242](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0242).
